input.command: cat notes/topic.md; echo ----; git fetch 2>&1; git status -sb; git remote -v; echo ----; ls -la; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; echo ----; cat /plugins/fd3/references/fact-routes.md

cat -n src/retry.ts; echo ----; cat -n src/jobs/sync.ts; echo ----; cat -n package.json; echo; ls -la .claude; find .claude -type f; ls package-lock.json yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml 2>&1; git log --oneline -5; echo $TMPDIR
node --version 2>&1; grep -rn "syncCatalog\|withRetry" --exclude-dir=.git . ; git branch -a; ls docs requirements 2>&1

S=/tmp/claude-1000/grill-retry-backoff; mkdir -p $S/notes $S/research
cat > $S/research/prior-conversation.md <<'EOF'
# Prior conversation
- (none) — /fd3:grill-topic was invoked as the first message with argument `notes/topic.md`; nothing was established before it.
EOF
cat > $S/research/INDEX.md <<'EOF'
# Research index

| ID | Question | Condensed answer | Sources | Report |
|----|----------|------------------|---------|--------|
| I1 | What attempt cap does withRetry use? | 5 attempts (`MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5`), not 3 as the topic says. | src/retry.ts:1 | inline |
| I2 | What does withRetry retry on? | Any thrown error, with no predicate and no delay; loop returns on first success. | src/retry.ts:5-10 | inline |
| I3 | Does syncCatalog's operation throw on supplier HTTP errors? | No. It calls `fetch` and discards the Response without checking `res.ok`; `fetch` resolves on 4xx/5xx, so only network-level failures (DNS, connection refused/reset) reach withRetry. A supplier answering 503 is not retried at all. The response body is also never read. | src/jobs/sync.ts:5 | inline |
| I4 | Callers of withRetry? | Only syncCatalog (src/jobs/sync.ts:4). syncCatalog itself has no caller or scheduler in the repo. | grep over repo | inline |
| I5 | Tooling / versions | No dependencies, no lockfile, no tsconfig. `test` script runs `vitest run` but vitest is not declared. No tests exist. Local Node is v26.10.0 (global fetch built in); no `engines` field. | package.json:5-7 | inline |
| I6 | Repo state / prior decisions | No git remote (fetch is a no-op, cannot check staleness); single branch `main`; no docs/specs/ADRs. | git remote -v, ls | inline |
EOF
echo ok

S=/tmp/claude-1000/grill-retry-backoff; cat > $S/notes/question-ledger.md <<'EOF'
# Question ledger

| # | Question | Round | Answer | Notes |
|---|----------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | Scope: does the work include making syncCatalog throw on supplier HTTP errors (5xx/429)? | 1 | open | facts: I3 |
| 2 | Attempt cap: keep 5, go to 3, or other? | 1 | open | facts: I1 |
| 3 | Jitter on the backoff delay? | 1 | open | |
| 4 | Backoff parameters hardcoded or an optional per-call options argument? | 1 | open | facts: I4 |
| 5 | Add vitest + unit tests for withRetry? | 1 | open | facts: I5 |
EOF
echo ok
